title: Will a robot be created that is capable of passing Steve Wozniak's "The Coffee Test" before 2029?
criteria: YES if a robot is publicly and credibly documented to enter and navigate an unfamiliar home, locate and manipulate coffee tools/ingredients, and prepare coffee within 20 minutes; supporting public documentation and reporting are required.
why: Both ask for a robot to make coffee in an unfamiliar home; the market adds a 20-minute limit and documentation standard, while our milestone explicitly requires a random, developer-unselected home, no prior mapping, and no human help.
